description:
A powerful virtual tour software that converts your panoramic or 360° photos and videos into interactive experiences.

Pano2VR is a powerful virtual tour software that converts your panoramic or 360° photos and videos into interactive experiences.
Whether you’re working on a single gigapixel panorama or a virtual tour with thousands of scenes, Pano2VR can help you create an immersive experience for any modern browser. Finished projects can be seamlessly integrated with existing websites and viewed on desktops and mobile or VR devices.
This is a bugfix release for Pano2VR 8.0. Changes:
- Convert Input now uses each panorama’s user data in output folder names when you convert from the Master Node
- Generating an output no longer hangs when the image of a node can't be read
- Zoom center at cursor pinching on an Android phone or a Windows touch screen keeps the point between your fingers in place, also when the tour is embedded in a page
- Pano2VR starts again on every supported macOS version
- The page inside a Garden Gnome Package now shows the tour's VR skin in VR, as the regular web output does
For the full list, check the What's new page.
